messages:
Alex: heads up — main is red right after merge of #4917 :rotating_light: failing `consistency-check` step on the rollout job. logs show a segfault in allocator on worker-3. commit: 6f3a9b2. Can someone grab?
CI Bot: build 4917 (merge 6f3a9b2) -> rollout:consistency-check FAILED. logs: https://ci.internal/red/4917/rollout/consistency-check (raw).
Maria: ack. assigning to oncall for quick triage. @Oncall who has bandwidth? :eyes:
Oncall: I can take a look in ~10m. Can we get a rerun meanwhile? if it's flaky a rerun might clear it.
Zoe: I can bisect if rerun keeps failing. quick check: is this the new allocator change from #4917?
Alex: yes, #4917 touched the memory allocator path for KV cache. suspecting edge-case in multi-GPU init. don't revert yet, let's rerun and collect core.
Maria: running rerun now: `ci retry --job rollout:consistency-check --build 4917`
CI Bot: rerun queued for rollout:consistency-check (build 4917). worker target: worker-4.
Oncall: while that's running, can someone add `ulimit -c unlimited` to the job to capture core? might help. if we get a core dump we can see the backtrace fast.
Zoe: adding it to deploy matrix now — quick patch applied to job definition, triggers a new rerun.
CI Bot: rerun started (build 4917, attempt 2). collecting logs and core dumps to https://ci.internal/artifacts/4917/attempt-2
Alex: thumbs if you want me to open a revert PR if this keeps failing after bisect. I can draft one fast.
Maria: trying to reproduce locally with the allocator flag. if I can get it to crash locally we can narrow down.
Zoe: if rerun passes we still should bisect against the allocator diff. flaky or timing-dependent failures are nasty.
CI Bot: rerun finished -> FAILURE. segfault signal 11 in `kv_alloc.cpp:237` on worker-4. core saved: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4917/attempt-2/core.
Oncall: ok bisect time. Zoe, can you start a bisection between 6f3a9b2 and the parent? I have one hypothesis about the thread init ordering.
Zoe: starting git bisect now, will post updates. first step: testing 6f3a9b2^ (parent).
Alex: thanks all. keep this thread updated — let's aim to have a revert ready within the hour if bisect points to #4917.
Zoe: bisect: parent passed the test locally in containerized run. narrowing.
Maria: thanks — grabbing logs and core to send to the allocator owners and tagging them in the bisect PR.
CI Bot: automated note: attaching core analysis (basic backtrace) to the build: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4917/analysis.txt
Oncall: pinging allocator owners: @alex @maria — please check backtrace.
Alex: reviewing backtrace now. will post a short summary in 15m.
